q.q: Many experts ---- that the use of plastic bags will decline sharply over the next decade.
q.e: anticipate = öngörmek. "Uzmanlar plastik poşet kullanımının önümüzdeki on yılda keskin biçimde azalacağını öngörüyor." Diğerleri: abandon (terk etmek), obtain (elde etmek), conceal (gizlemek), inhabit (yaşamak).

q.q: The new medicine has been shown to ---- the symptoms of the disease, although it cannot cure it.
q.e: alleviate = hafifletmek. İlaç hastalığı tedavi edemiyor ama belirtileri hafifletiyor. "Although it cannot cure it" ipucu verir: tedavi değil, hafifletme.

q.q: Because water is ---- in desert regions, people there have developed clever ways of storing it.
q.e: scarce = kıt. Çölde su kıt olduğu için insanlar onu saklamanın yollarını bulmuş. abundant (bol) tam tersi anlamdadır.

q.q: The government has ---- extra funds to schools in poor areas in order to improve the quality of education.
q.e: allocate = tahsis etmek, ayırmak. Hükümet yoksul bölgelerdeki okullara ek fon ayırdı. "deprived" (yoksun bıraktı) anlamca tam tersidir.

q.q: The results of the experiment were ----, so the scientists decided to repeat it with a larger group.
q.e: ambiguous = belirsiz, muğlak. Sonuçlar belirsiz olduğu için deney daha büyük bir grupla tekrarlandı.

q.q: Some researchers ---- the rise in allergies to modern lifestyles and a lack of contact with nature.
q.e: attribute X to Y = X'i Y'ye bağlamak, atfetmek. Alerjilerdeki artışı modern yaşam tarzına bağlıyorlar.

q.q: Regular exercise not only improves physical health but also ---- mood and self-confidence.
q.e: boost = artırmak, güçlendirmek. "Not only improves … but also boosts": egzersiz ruh halini de güçlendirir. Diğerleri olumsuz anlamlıdır.

q.q: The earthquake had a ---- effect on the region, destroying thousands of homes.
q.e: devastating = yıkıcı. "Binlerce evi yıkarak" ifadesi etkinin çok büyük ve yıkıcı olduğunu gösterir.

q.q: Children who are ---- of a good education often find it difficult to escape poverty later in life.
q.e: deprived of = -den yoksun bırakılmış. İyi eğitimden yoksun kalan çocuklar yoksulluktan kurtulmakta zorlanır.

q.q: Without ---- evidence, the court could not convict the suspect.
q.e: sufficient = yeterli. Yeterli kanıt olmadan mahkeme şüpheliyi mahkûm edemedi.

q.q: Scientists hope the new vaccine will help to ---- the disease completely within the next twenty years.
q.e: eradicate = kökünü kazımak. Aşının hastalığı tamamen yok etmesi umuluyor. "Completely" ipucu.

q.q: The two studies reached ---- conclusions, so more research is needed to find out which one is correct.
q.e: contradictory = çelişkili. Hangisinin doğru olduğunu bulmak için daha çok araştırma gerektiğine göre sonuçlar birbiriyle çelişiyor.

q.q: The museum has ---- its opening hours so that more visitors can come in the evening.
q.e: extend = uzatmak. Ziyaretçiler akşam da gelebilsin diye çalışma saatleri uzatılmış.

q.q: Smoking is ---- to health, and it is the leading cause of preventable death in many countries.
q.e: detrimental = zararlı. Sigara önlenebilir ölümlerin başlıca nedeniyse sağlığa zararlıdır.

q.q: It is ---- that most people prefer to work in a quiet environment, as noise reduces concentration.
q.e: evident = açık, belli. Gürültü konsantrasyonu azalttığına göre çoğu insanın sessiz ortamı tercih ettiği açıktır.

q.q: Many old buildings in the city centre were ---- for years before the government finally decided to restore them.
q.e: neglect = ihmal etmek. Hükümet sonunda restorasyona karar verene kadar binalar yıllarca ihmal edilmiş.

q.q: The company had to ---- 300 workers because of the economic crisis.
q.e: lay off = işten çıkarmak. Ekonomik kriz yüzünden şirket 300 işçiyi çıkarmak zorunda kaldı.

q.q: The study was ---- by a team of researchers from three different universities.
q.e: carry out = yürütmek, gerçekleştirmek. Çalışma üç üniversiteden bir ekip tarafından yürütüldü.

q.q: Unemployment among young people has risen ----, reaching its highest level in twenty years.
q.e: sharply = keskin biçimde. Yirmi yılın en yüksek düzeyine ulaştığına göre artış büyük ve hızlı olmuş.

q.q: Some animals are ---- to cold weather and cannot survive in northern regions.
q.e: vulnerable = savunmasız, hassas. Kuzey bölgelerde hayatta kalamadıklarına göre soğuğa karşı savunmasızlar. "Resistant" (dirençli) ise tam tersi.

q.q: In many countries, education is ---- for children between the ages of six and fourteen.
q.e: mandatory = zorunlu. Altı ile on dört yaş arası çocuklar için eğitim zorunludur.

q.q: The doctor ---- that the patient should rest for at least two weeks.
q.e: insist that = ısrar etmek. Doktor hastanın en az iki hafta dinlenmesi gerektiğinde ısrar etti. Diğerleri benzer görünür ama anlamları uymaz.

q.q: The number of tourists visiting the region ---- greatly from season to season.
q.e: fluctuate = dalgalanmak, inip çıkmak. Turist sayısı mevsimden mevsime büyük değişiklik gösterir.

q.q: Although the theory sounds ----, there is still no scientific evidence to support it.
q.e: plausible = akla yatkın. "Although … there is no evidence" zıtlığı: teori akla yatkın görünse de kanıt yok.

q.q: Traditional crafts are slowly disappearing, and many experts fear they may soon become ----.
q.e: extinct = yok olmuş. Zanaatlar kaybolduğuna göre yakında tamamen yok olabilir. Burada mecazi anlamda kullanılmış.

q.q: The report ---- the importance of early education for children's later success.
q.e: emphasize = vurgulamak. Rapor erken eğitimin önemini vurguluyor.

q.q: Climate change will ---- affect poor countries, which have fewer resources to adapt.
q.e: disproportionately = orantısız biçimde. Kaynakları az olan yoksul ülkeler orantısız biçimde etkilenecek. Diğer şıklar "neredeyse hiç" anlamı taşır ve mantığa uymaz.

q.q: The ---- of the disease is sudden: patients usually feel ill within a few hours.
q.e: onset = başlangıç. Hastalığın başlangıcı ani: birkaç saat içinde belirti verir.

q.q: The government is trying to ---- inflation by raising interest rates.
q.e: curb = dizginlemek. Faiz oranlarını artırmak enflasyonu dizginlemek içindir. "Boost" ve "foster" artırmak anlamındadır.

q.q: Many people are ---- to change their habits, even when they know the habits are harmful.
q.e: reluctant = isteksiz. "Even when they know" zıtlığı: zararlı olduğunu bilseler bile değişmeye isteksizler.

q.q: The new law ---- companies to publish information about their carbon emissions.
q.e: require = gerektirmek, zorunlu kılmak. Yasa şirketlerin salım bilgilerini yayınlamasını zorunlu kılıyor. "Require X to do" kalıbı.

q.q: The scientists were unable to ---- their earlier results, which raised doubts about the original study.
q.e: replicate = tekrarlamak (aynı sonucu elde etmek). Sonuçlar tekrarlanamayınca ilk çalışmaya şüpheyle bakıldı.

q.q: Honey bees play a ---- role in agriculture, as they pollinate many of the crops we eat.
q.e: crucial = çok önemli. Yediğimiz ürünlerin çoğunu tozlaştırdıklarına göre rolleri çok önemli.

q.q: It is ---- to drive after drinking alcohol, as it greatly increases the risk of accidents.
q.e: reckless = pervasız, düşüncesiz. Kaza riskini çok artırdığına göre içkili araç kullanmak pervasızlıktır.

q.q: The two languages ---- each other in grammar, although their vocabularies are very different.
q.e: resemble = benzemek. Kelime dağarcıkları farklı olsa da dilbilgisi açısından birbirine benziyorlar.

q.q: She has been ---- the same job for fifteen years and wants a change.
q.e: "Do a job" doğru eşdizimdir (collocation). Make, take, give ile job kullanılmaz.

q.q: The ---- of the study was to find out whether diet affects memory.
q.e: objective = amaç. Çalışmanın amacı beslenmenin hafızayı etkileyip etkilemediğini bulmaktı.

q.q: Because of the heavy snow, the match was ---- until next week.
q.e: postpone = ertelemek. "Until next week" ifadesi iptal değil erteleme olduğunu gösterir.

q.q: The ---- majority of scientists agree that human activity is causing global warming.
q.e: overwhelming majority = ezici çoğunluk. Bu sık kullanılan bir eşdizimdir.

q.q: The disease is ---- in tropical areas, where mosquitoes are common.
q.e: prevalent = yaygın. Sivrisineğin yaygın olduğu tropik bölgelerde hastalık da yaygındır.

q.q: Poor nutrition during childhood can ---- brain development.
q.e: impair = zayıflatmak, bozmak. Kötü beslenme beyin gelişimini olumsuz etkiler; diğer şıklar olumlu anlamlıdır.

q.q: The two countries finally reached an agreement after months of difficult ----.
q.e: negotiation = müzakere. Aylarca süren zor müzakerelerden sonra anlaşmaya vardılar.

q.q: The internet has made information more ---- to people in remote areas.
q.e: accessible = erişilebilir. İnternet uzak bölgelerdeki insanlar için bilgiyi daha erişilebilir kıldı.

q.q: The heavy rain ---- serious flooding in the north of the country.
q.e: give rise to = neden olmak. Şiddetli yağmur ciddi sellere neden oldu.

q.q: Our ancestors had to ---- harsh conditions, such as cold winters and lack of food.
q.e: endure = katlanmak, dayanmak. Atalarımız soğuk kışlar ve yiyecek kıtlığı gibi zorlu koşullara katlanmak zorundaydı.

q.q: Scientists still do not fully understand the ---- by which birds find their way over long distances.
q.e: mechanism = mekanizma, işleyiş. "By which" ile birlikte "…'yi sağlayan mekanizma" anlamı kurulur.

q.q: Most of the participants found the task ----, so they lost interest quickly.
q.e: tedious = sıkıcı. İlgilerini çabuk kaybettiklerine göre görev sıkıcıydı.

q.q: The new policy aims to ---- the gap between rich and poor.
q.e: narrow the gap = uçurumu daraltmak. Politikanın amacı farkı azaltmak; diğerleri farkı artırma anlamı taşır.

q.q: Learning a second language is ---- easier for children who start at an early age.
q.e: considerably = önemli ölçüde. Karşılaştırma sıfatı (easier) önünde güçlendirici olarak considerably, much, far kullanılır.

q.q: The findings of the study ---- with those of earlier research, which supports their reliability.
q.e: be consistent with = tutarlı olmak. Önceki araştırmalarla tutarlı olduğu için güvenilirliği destekleniyor. "Which supports" ipucu verir.

q.q: By the time the ambulance arrived, the injured man ---- a lot of blood.
q.e: "By the time + geçmiş zaman" kalıbında diğer eylem daha önce bitmiş olduğu için past perfect (had lost) gelir.

q.q: Over the past ten years, the number of people working from home ---- dramatically.
q.e: "Over the past ten years" geçmişten bugüne uzanan bir süreyi anlatır; present perfect gerekir.

q.q: Gutenberg ---- the printing press in the fifteenth century.
q.e: Belirli bir geçmiş zaman (in the fifteenth century) varsa past simple kullanılır.

q.q: I ---- dinner when the lights suddenly went out.
q.e: Geçmişte devam eden bir eylem (yemek yiyordum) sırasında kısa bir olay (ışıklar gitti) olmuş: past continuous.

q.q: By 2050, scientists believe, the world's population ---- nearly ten billion.
q.e: "By 2050" gelecekte bir son noktadır; o zamana kadar tamamlanmış olacak eylem için future perfect (will have reached).

q.q: Water ---- at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
q.e: Genel bilimsel gerçekler geniş zamanla anlatılır.

q.q: She ---- in Ankara since she graduated from university.
q.e: "Since + geçmiş olay" ile başlayıp hâlâ süren durumlar present perfect ister.

q.q: When I got to the station, the train ---- already ----.
q.e: "Already" ve geçmişteki bir andan önce tamamlanma: past perfect (had left).

q.q: Prices ---- steadily these days because of the rising cost of energy.
q.e: "These days" şu günlerde süren geçici bir durumu anlatır: present continuous.

q.q: The researchers ---- the data for three months before they published their findings.
q.e: Geçmişteki bir olaydan (yayımlama) önce bir süre devam etmiş eylem: past perfect continuous.

q.q: John didn't answer the phone. He ---- asleep.
q.e: Geçmişe yönelik kesine yakın tahmin: must have + V3. "Uyuyor olmalıydı."

q.q: You ---- me you were coming. I would have prepared something.
q.e: Geçmişte yapılmayan bir şey için sitem: should have + V3. "Bana söylemeliydin."

q.q: She ---- the letter; she was in another country at the time.
q.e: Geçmişte imkânsız bir durum: can't have + V3. "Yazmış olamaz, o sırada başka ülkedeydi."

q.q: You ---- bring any food; there will be plenty at the party.
q.e: "Gerek yok" anlamı don't have to ile verilir. Mustn't ise yasak anlamı taşır.

q.q: The road is closed, so we ---- take another route.
q.e: Yol kapalı olduğu için zorunluluk var: will have to.

q.q: The missing documents ---- stolen, but it is also possible that they were simply lost.
q.e: "It is also possible" ifadesi kesin olmayan bir olasılığı gösterir: may have been.

q.q: Students ---- use mobile phones during the exam; it is strictly forbidden.
q.e: Kesin yasak: mustn't.

q.q: When I was a child, I ---- swim for hours without getting tired.
q.e: Geçmişteki yetenek: could.

q.q: The new bridge ---- by thousands of cars every day.
q.e: Köprü kendi kendine bir şey kullanamaz; edilgen gerekir. Genel durum: is used.

q.q: The results of the survey ---- next month.
q.e: Sonuçlar yayımlanır (edilgen), zaman gelecek: will be published.

q.q: Many species ---- because of the destruction of rainforests.
q.e: Türler kaybedilir (edilgen) ve bu süreç bugüne kadar süren bir sonuç: have been lost.

q.q: It ---- that the city was founded more than 3,000 years ago.
q.e: "It is believed that…" bilimsel metinlerde yaygın edilgen kalıbıdır.

q.q: The patient ---- to hospital immediately after the accident.
q.e: Hasta hastaneye götürüldü (edilgen), geçmişte bitmiş bir olay: was taken.

q.q: The project is expected ---- by the end of the year.
q.e: "Be expected to" kalıbından sonra edilgen mastar: to be completed.

q.q: The ancient city is thought ---- by an earthquake.
q.e: Geçmişte olmuş edilgen bir olay için "is thought to have been + V3".

q.q: If I ---- more time, I would learn another language.
q.e: Type 2 (şimdiki hayali durum): If + past simple, would + V1.

q.q: If she had left earlier, she ---- the train.
q.e: Type 3 (geçmişte gerçekleşmemiş durum): would have + V3.

q.q: You will not pass the exam ---- you study regularly.
q.e: unless = if not. "Düzenli çalışmazsan geçemezsin."

q.q: Take a map with you ---- you get lost.
q.e: in case = olur da diye. "Kaybolursan diye yanına harita al."

q.q: ---- I known about the meeting, I would have attended it.
q.e: Type 3 devrik yapısı: Had I known = If I had known.

q.q: If you heat ice, it ----.
q.e: Type 0 (genel gerçek): If + present, present.

q.q: You can borrow my car ---- you drive carefully.
q.e: as long as = -dığı sürece, -mek şartıyla.

q.q: Hurry up, ---- we will miss the beginning of the film.
q.e: otherwise = aksi halde.

q.q: The scientist ---- discovered penicillin was Alexander Fleming.
q.e: İnsan için özne konumunda who.

q.q: This is the village ---- my grandfather was born.
q.e: Yer bildiren isimden sonra arkada tam bir cümle varsa where.

q.q: The company, ---- headquarters are in Istanbul, employs 5,000 people.
q.e: Sahiplik (şirketin merkezi): whose.

q.q: He passed the exam with a high score, ---- surprised everyone.
q.e: Cümlenin tamamını niteleyen virgüllü yapıda which kullanılır; virgülden sonra that gelmez.

q.q: The method by ---- the data were collected is explained in the next section.
q.e: Edattan sonra nesne için which (by which). Edattan sonra that kullanılmaz.

q.q: She has three brothers, all of ---- live abroad.
q.e: "All of / some of / most of" yapısından sonra insanlar için whom.

q.q: I will never forget the day ---- we first met.
q.e: Zaman bildiren isimden sonra when.

q.q: Scientists still do not know ---- the dinosaurs disappeared so suddenly.
q.e: Neden belirsiz: "Dinozorların neden aniden yok olduğunu bilmiyorlar." İsim cümleciği why ile kurulur.

q.q: ---- surprised me most was his calm reaction.
q.e: "Beni en çok şaşırtan şey" = What. What kendi içinde özne eksiği olan bir cümlecik kurar.

q.q: It is not yet clear ---- the new treatment will be effective.
q.e: "-ip -meyeceği belli değil" anlamı whether ile verilir.

q.q: Recent studies show ---- regular exercise can improve memory.
q.e: Arkasından eksiksiz bir cümle geliyor; bilgi aktaran that.

q.q: The fact ---- he apologized did not change her decision.
q.e: "The fact that…" kalıbı: …olduğu gerçeği.

q.q: ---- it was raining heavily, the football match was not cancelled.
q.e: Zıtlık var ve arkasından cümle geliyor: although. Despite'tan sonra isim gelir.

q.q: ---- the heavy rain, the match went on as planned.
q.e: Zıtlık var ve arkasından isim (the heavy rain) geliyor: despite.

q.q: The flight was delayed ---- bad weather conditions.
q.e: Sebep ve arkasından isim: due to. Because'ten sonra cümle gelir.

q.q: He studied very hard; ----, he failed the exam.
q.e: Çok çalıştı ama kaldı: zıtlık bağlacı nevertheless. Therefore, thus ve consequently sonuç bildirir.

q.q: The plan is cheap and easy to apply. ----, it has already been tested successfully.
q.e: Olumlu bir bilgiye başka bir olumlu bilgi ekleniyor: Moreover (üstelik).

q.q: He was ---- tired that he fell asleep in the meeting.
q.e: "so + sıfat + that": o kadar … ki. Such'tan sonra isim öbeği gelir (such a tired man).

q.q: She is saving money ---- she can buy a house next year.
q.e: Amaç bildiren ve arkasından cümle (özne + fiil) alan bağlaç: so that. In order to'dan sonra yalın fiil gelir.

q.q: Some people prefer to live in cities, ---- others prefer the countryside.
q.e: İki grubu karşılaştıran zıtlık: whereas (oysa).

q.q: ---- you are already here, you can help me with this report.
q.e: Since burada "madem, -dığı için" anlamında sebep bildirir.

q.q: Not only ---- the medicine cheap, but it is also very effective.
q.e: Not only cümle başında olduğu için devrik yapı: Not only is the medicine cheap…

q.q: She managed ---- the problem without any help.
q.e: manage + to + fiil.

q.q: You should avoid ---- too much sugar.
q.e: avoid + fiil-ing.

q.q: I look forward to ---- from you soon.
q.e: "Look forward to" kalıbındaki to bir edattır; arkasından -ing gelir.

q.q: He is used to ---- at night because he is a nurse.
q.e: "Be used to" = alışkın olmak; to edat olduğu için -ing gelir. "Used to + V1" (eskiden -erdi) ile karıştırma.

q.q: They decided ---- to a bigger city.
q.e: decide + to + fiil.

q.q: He stopped ---- after the doctor warned him about his lungs.
q.e: stop + -ing = bırakmak. Stop + to = bir şey yapmak için durmak (anlamca uymaz).

q.q: The job involves ---- a lot of reports.
q.e: involve + fiil-ing.

q.q: The new model is ---- more efficient than the old one.
q.e: Karşılaştırma sıfatını güçlendirmek için far, much, a lot kullanılır; "very more" yanlıştır.

q.q: The more you practise, ---- you will become.
q.e: "The more …, the more …" kalıbı: ne kadar çok …, o kadar ….

q.q: This is ---- book I have ever read.
q.e: "Ever read" ile üstünlük derecesi: the most interesting.

q.q: Train travel is not ---- expensive as air travel.
q.e: "not as … as": … kadar değil.

q.q: Very ---- people know the real reason for the decision.
q.e: People sayılabilen çoğuldur; "çok az" anlamında few.

q.q: There is ---- time left, so we must hurry.
q.e: Time sayılamaz; "çok az" anlamında little.

q.q: ---- the teacher nor the students knew the answer.
q.e: "Neither … nor": ne … ne.

q.q: You can choose ---- tea or coffee.
q.e: "Either … or": ya … ya.

q.q: The success of the project depends ---- the support of local people.
q.e: depend on = -e bağlı olmak.

q.q: The accident resulted ---- three deaths.
q.e: result in = ile sonuçlanmak. Result from ise "kaynaklanmak" demektir.

q.q: There has been a sharp increase ---- the price of food.
q.e: increase in + şey: bir şeydeki artış.

q.q: Oranges are rich ---- vitamin C.
q.e: rich in = bakımından zengin.

q.q: The team consists ---- eleven players.
q.e: consist of = -den oluşmak.

q.q: He said that he ---- the report the next day.
q.e: Geçmiş zamanlı rapor fiilinden (said) sonra will → would olur.

q.q: The doctor suggested that she ---- more rest.
q.e: "Suggest that + özne + yalın fiil" (subjunctive) kalıbı.

q.q: No sooner ---- home than the phone rang.
q.e: "No sooner had + özne + V3 … than": -er -mez.

q.q: Never ---- such a beautiful sunset.
q.e: Never cümle başına gelince devrik yapı: Never have I seen.

q.q: ---- you have any questions, please contact us.
q.e: "Should you have" = If you have. Koşul devrik yapısı.

q.q: Although the new treatment seemed promising in early trials, ----.
o: scientists were very pleased with the results
it was widely used in hospitals
patients who received it recovered quickly
it was approved by doctors in many countries
later studies failed to confirm its effectiveness
q.e: "Although" zıtlık bağlacıdır: ilk denemeler umut verici olsa da sonraki çalışmalar etkinliğini doğrulayamadı. Diğer şıklar zıtlık değil, olumlu devam bildiriyor.

q.q: If governments do not take urgent action to reduce carbon emissions, ----.
o: the climate has always changed naturally
scientists had warned about climate change
global temperatures will continue to rise
people would have used less energy
q.e: Type 1 koşul: If + present, will + V1. Sadece A zaman uyumuna ve anlama uyuyor.

q.q: ----, the company decided to close two of its factories.
o: As long as the workers agree
Since sales had fallen sharply over the previous year
Even though its profits were higher than ever
Whereas its competitors were also struggling
q.e: Fabrika kapatma kararının nedeni: satışların keskin düşüşü. Since burada sebep bildirir. Even though anlamca çelişir.

q.q: Children learn languages more easily than adults, ----.
o: unless they live in a foreign country
whereas adults often make faster progress at the beginning
so they never forget what they learn
because they spend less time practising
which is why adults should not study languages
q.e: Çocuklar ile yetişkinler arasında karşılaştırma: whereas (oysa). Diğer seçenekler mantıksız ya da aşırı genelleme içeriyor.

q.q: The museum was so crowded ----.
o: that we could hardly see the paintings
because it was a public holiday
q.e: "So + sıfat + that" kalıbı: o kadar kalabalıktı ki tabloları zor gördük.

q.q: No sooner had the meeting started ----.
o: than the fire alarm went off
q.e: "No sooner … than" kalıbı sabittir.

q.q: People who exercise regularly are less likely to suffer from heart disease, ----.
o: unless they eat a healthy diet
whereas exercise has no effect on health
which suggests that physical activity protects the heart
q.e: ", which suggests…" cümlenin tamamını niteleyip bir sonuç çıkarıyor. Diğerleri ilk cümleyle çelişiyor.

q.q: Had the scientists collected more data, ----.
o: they will publish their findings next year
their conclusions would have been more reliable
q.e: "Had + özne + V3" = If they had collected (Type 3). Ana cümlede would have + V3 gerekir.

q.q: While many people believe that money brings happiness, ----.
o: most people want to earn more money
rich people usually live in big cities
happiness depends on many factors such as money
money is necessary to buy food and clothes
research shows that, beyond a certain level, more income does not make people happier
q.e: While burada zıtlık bildirir: yaygın inancın tersini gösteren araştırma.

q.q: The project was cancelled ----.
o: in case the funds arrived late
although it had enough money and staff
so that it could be completed on time
because the government could not provide the necessary funds
whereas the results were very positive
q.e: İptalin mantıklı nedeni: gerekli fonun sağlanamaması.

q.q: Unless the patient's condition improves within the next 24 hours, ----.
o: the doctors will have to operate
q.e: Unless + present = if not; ana cümle will + V1 ister.

q.q: The more we learn about the brain, ----.
o: the more we realize how complex it is
it is the most important organ
scientists have studied it for years
q.e: "The more …, the more …" kalıbı.

q.q: Despite having lived in London for ten years, ----.
o: he still speaks very little English
q.e: Despite zıtlık bildirir: on yıl yaşamasına rağmen hâlâ çok az İngilizce konuşuyor.

q.q: It is widely believed that breakfast is the most important meal of the day; ----.
o: however, recent studies have questioned this idea
for example, many people eat eggs
q.e: "It is widely believed" ifadesinden sonra genellikle bu inancı sorgulayan however cümlesi gelir.

q.q: So that young people can find jobs more easily, ----.
o: unemployment among the young is very high
the government has started a new training programme
q.e: "So that" amaç bildirir; amacı gerçekleştirmek için yapılan eylem: yeni eğitim programı.

q.q: The ancient city remained hidden for centuries ----.
o: whereas it was built 3,000 years ago
so that tourists could visit it
until it was discovered by farmers in 1963
because it was very large and famous
q.e: "Until" = -e kadar: yüzyıllarca gizli kaldı ta ki 1963'te bulunana kadar.

q.q: Not only does the new car use less fuel, ----.
o: it uses more fuel than the old model
but it is also cheaper to repair
q.e: "Not only … but also" ikili yapısı.

q.q: ----, scientists are still unable to predict exactly when an earthquake will happen.
o: Since scientists know everything about earthquakes
So that people can be warned
q.e: Teknolojinin gelişmesine rağmen tahmin yapılamıyor: zıtlık bağlacı although.

q.q: As the population of the city has grown rapidly, ----.
o: many people have left the city
the demand for housing has also increased
q.e: As burada sebep bildirir: nüfus artınca konut talebi de arttı.

q.q: The study, ----, found a strong link between stress and heart disease.
o: which was conducted over twenty years
that it was conducted in Canada
q.e: Virgüllü ilgi cümleciği ek bilgi veriyor: which was conducted. Virgülden sonra that kullanılmaz.

q.q: Many scientists believe that climate change will cause more frequent and severe droughts in the coming decades.
o: Önümüzdeki on yıllarda iklim değişikliği bazı bilim insanlarına göre kuraklığı azaltacaktır.
İklim değişikliğinin daha sık kuraklıklara neden olduğuna inanan bilim insanı sayısı gelecek on yıllarda artacak.
Birçok bilim insanına göre iklim değişikliği son on yıllarda sık sık şiddetli kuraklıklara neden olmuştur.
Birçok bilim insanı, iklim değişikliğinin önümüzdeki on yıllarda daha sık ve şiddetli kuraklıklara yol açacağına inanmaktadır.
Bilim insanları, şiddetli kuraklıkların iklim değişikliğinden kaynaklandığına önümüzdeki yıllarda inanacak.
q.e: Zaman (will cause = yol açacak), öznenin kim olduğu (birçok bilim insanı inanıyor) ve sıfatlar (more frequent and severe = daha sık ve şiddetli) yalnızca ilk şıkta doğru.

q.q: Although the city is famous for its historical buildings, most tourists spend only one day there.
o: Şehrin tarihi binaları bir günde görülebileceği için turistler orada az kalıyor.
Turistlerin çoğu, tarihi binaları nedeniyle şehri tek bir günde gezmeyi tercih ediyor.
Şehir tarihi binalarıyla ünlü olduğu için turistlerin çoğu orada bir günden fazla kalıyor.
Tarihi binalarıyla ünlü olan şehre gelen turistler bir gün içinde ayrılmak zorunda kalıyor.
Şehir tarihi binalarıyla ünlü olmasına rağmen turistlerin çoğu orada sadece bir gün geçiriyor.
q.e: Although = -e rağmen (zıtlık). "Most tourists" = turistlerin çoğu, "only one day" = sadece bir gün.

q.q: The new law, which will come into force next year, aims to reduce the amount of plastic waste.
o: Yeni yasanın gelecek yıl plastik atıkları tamamen ortadan kaldırması bekleniyor.
Plastik atık miktarını azaltmak için gelecek yıl yeni bir yasa hazırlanacak.
Gelecek yıl yürürlüğe girecek olan yeni yasa, plastik atık miktarını azaltmayı amaçlıyor.
Plastik atıkları azaltmayı amaçlayan yasa gelecek yıl yeniden gözden geçirilecek.
Geçen yıl yürürlüğe giren yeni yasa, plastik atık miktarını büyük ölçüde azalttı.
q.e: "Which will come into force next year" = gelecek yıl yürürlüğe girecek olan; "aims to reduce" = azaltmayı amaçlıyor.

q.q: It is not yet known whether the drug has any long-term side effects.
o: Henüz uzun vadeli yan etkisi bilinmeyen ilacın kullanımı yasaklandı.
İlacın uzun vadeli herhangi bir yan etkisi olup olmadığı henüz bilinmiyor.
İlacın yan etkileri uzun süre sonra ortaya çıkabilir.
İlacın uzun süre kullanılmasının yan etkilere neden olacağı henüz kanıtlanmadı.
İlacın uzun vadede ciddi yan etkileri olduğu bilinmektedir.
q.e: "Whether … has any" = herhangi bir … olup olmadığı; "not yet known" = henüz bilinmiyor.

q.q: The more time children spend in front of screens, the less time they have for physical activity.
o: Çocuklar fiziksel etkinlik için ekran karşısında daha çok zaman geçirmelidir.
Çocukların ekran karşısında geçirdiği zaman, fiziksel etkinliğe ayırdıkları zamandan daha azdır.
Çocuklar ekran karşısında ne kadar çok zaman geçirirse fiziksel etkinliğe o kadar az zamanları kalır.
Fiziksel etkinlik yapan çocuklar ekran karşısında daha az zaman geçirir.
Ekran karşısında az zaman geçiren çocuklar daha çok spor yapar.
q.e: "The more …, the less …" = ne kadar çok …, o kadar az ….

q.q: Had the government acted earlier, the crisis could have been prevented.
o: Hükümet daha erken harekete geçseydi kriz önlenebilirdi.
Hükümetin krizi önlemek için daha erken harekete geçmesi gerekiyor.
Hükümet krizden önce harekete geçmeyi düşünmüştü.
Kriz önlenemediği için hükümet harekete geçmek zorunda kaldı.
Hükümet erken harekete geçtiği için kriz önlendi.
q.e: "Had the government acted" = If the government had acted (geçmişte gerçekleşmemiş koşul): geçseydi. "Could have been prevented" = önlenebilirdi.

q.q: Researchers have found that people who sleep less than six hours a night are more likely to gain weight.
o: Gecede altı saat uyuyan kişilerin daha az kilo aldığı araştırmalarla kanıtlandı.
Araştırmalar, kilolu kişilerin gecede altı saatten az uyuduğunu gösteriyor.
Araştırmacılar az uyumanın kilo kaybına yol açtığını buldu.
Araştırmacılar, kilo vermek isteyenlerin gecede en az altı saat uyuması gerektiğini söylüyor.
Araştırmacılar, gecede altı saatten az uyuyan kişilerin kilo alma olasılığının daha yüksek olduğunu buldu.
q.e: "Are more likely to gain weight" = kilo alma olasılığı daha yüksek. Neden-sonuç yönüne dikkat: az uyku → kilo alma.

q.q: Unless water resources are managed carefully, many regions will face serious shortages.
o: Birçok bölge, su kaynaklarını dikkatli yönetmediği için kıtlık yaşıyor.
Su kaynakları dikkatli yönetilmezse birçok bölge ciddi kıtlıklarla karşı karşıya kalacak.
Su kaynakları dikkatli yönetildiği sürece hiçbir bölge kıtlık yaşamayacak.
Su kaynaklarının dikkatsizce yönetilmesi bazı bölgelerde kıtlığa yol açtı.
Su kıtlığı yaşayan bölgeler kaynaklarını daha dikkatli yönetmeli.
q.e: "Unless" = -mezse. "Will face" = karşı karşıya kalacak (gelecek).

q.q: Bu çalışmanın sonuçları, beslenmenin ruh sağlığı üzerinde önemli bir etkisi olduğunu göstermektedir.
o: The results of this study show that diet has a significant effect on mental health.
This study was conducted to show the effect of mental health on diet.
This study shows that mental health has a significant effect on diet.
The results of this study will show whether diet affects mental health.
According to this study, a good diet is the most important factor for mental health.
q.e: Yön önemli: beslenme → ruh sağlığı. "Effect on" = üzerinde etki. Zaman geniş zaman (show).

q.q: Şehirde yaşayan insanların sayısı son elli yılda iki katına çıktı.
o: People living in cities had doubled their number fifty years ago.
The number of people who will live in cities is expected to double in fifty years.
The city population doubles every fifty years.
Fifty years ago, twice as many people lived in cities.
The number of people living in cities has doubled over the last fifty years.
q.e: "Son elli yılda" (over the last fifty years) present perfect ister: has doubled.

q.q: Doktorlar, hastalığın erken teşhis edilmesinin tedaviyi çok daha etkili hale getirdiğini vurguluyor.
o: Doctors emphasize that the disease must be treated early to be diagnosed effectively.
Early treatment of the disease is emphasized by doctors as being effective.
Doctors emphasize that early diagnosis of the disease makes treatment much more effective.
Doctors say that the disease is usually diagnosed too late to be treated.
According to doctors, effective treatment makes early diagnosis possible.
q.e: "Erken teşhis" = early diagnosis; "tedaviyi çok daha etkili hale getiriyor" = makes treatment much more effective.

q.q: Eğer daha fazla zamanım olsaydı, düzenli olarak spor yapardım.
o: Although I have more time, I don't do sport regularly.
I would have more time if I did sport regularly.
If I have more time, I will do sport regularly.
If I had had more time, I would have done sport regularly.
If I had more time, I would do sport regularly.
q.e: "Olsaydı … yapardım" şimdiki hayali durum: Type 2 (If + past, would + V1).

q.q: Teknolojideki hızlı gelişmelere rağmen, birçok kırsal bölgede hâlâ internet erişimi bulunmamaktadır.
o: Because technology develops rapidly, rural areas will soon have internet access.
Rapid developments in technology have caused rural areas to lose internet access.
Thanks to rapid developments in technology, many rural areas now have internet access.
Many rural areas do not need internet access despite developments in technology.
Despite rapid developments in technology, many rural areas still do not have internet access.
q.e: "-e rağmen" = despite; "hâlâ … bulunmamaktadır" = still do not have.

q.q: Arıların sayısındaki azalmanın başlıca nedenlerinden biri, tarımda kimyasal kullanımıdır.
o: The decline in the number of bees has led to the use of chemicals in agriculture.
One of the main reasons for the decline in the number of bees is the use of chemicals in agriculture.
The main reason why farmers use chemicals is the decline in the number of bees.
Chemicals used in agriculture will reduce the number of bees in the future.
The number of bees has declined because of only one reason: chemicals.
q.e: "Başlıca nedenlerinden biri" = one of the main reasons; neden-sonuç yönü: kimyasal → arı azalması.

q.q: Hükümet, gençler arasındaki işsizliği azaltmak amacıyla yeni bir program başlattı.
o: The government's new programme aims to find jobs for unemployed adults.
The government launched a new programme, which increased unemployment among young people.
Unemployment among young people will be reduced by the government next year.
The government has launched a new programme in order to reduce unemployment among young people.
Young people started a new programme to reduce unemployment.
q.e: "Azaltmak amacıyla" = in order to reduce; "gençler arasındaki işsizlik" = unemployment among young people.

q.q: The book was so boring that I couldn't finish it.
o: The book was too boring for me to finish.
The book was boring, but I finished it anyway.
I finished the book although it was very long.
I didn't like the book, so I gave it to a friend.
I couldn't finish the book because I didn't have time.
q.e: "So … that … couldn't" = "too … to" (o kadar … ki … -emedim). Anlam aynı.

q.q: Unless you book a table in advance, you may not find a place at the restaurant.
o: Booking a table in advance is not necessary at this restaurant.
You can always find a place at the restaurant, even without booking.
If you don't book a table in advance, you may not find a place at the restaurant.
The restaurant only accepts customers who book in advance.
You must book a table if you want to eat there tomorrow.
q.e: Unless = if not. Anlamı birebir koruyan tek şık A.

q.q: It is believed that the ancient city was destroyed by an earthquake.
o: Scientists have proved that an earthquake destroyed the ancient city.
An earthquake will probably destroy the ancient city.
People believe that the ancient city survived an earthquake.
The ancient city is believed to have been destroyed by an earthquake.
The ancient city was built after an earthquake.
q.e: "It is believed that … was destroyed" = "is believed to have been destroyed". E şıkkı "kanıtlandı" diyerek anlamı güçlendiriyor; bu yanlıştır.

q.q: Despite her lack of experience, she was offered the job.
o: She refused the job because she had little experience.
Although she didn't have much experience, she was offered the job.
She didn't get the job because she had no experience.
She was offered the job because of her experience.
She gained experience before she was offered the job.
q.e: Despite + isim = Although + cümle. Zıtlık anlamı korunuyor.

q.q: He had no sooner sat down than the phone rang.
o: He sat down because the phone was ringing.
The phone rang a long time after he sat down.
The phone rang before he sat down.
He didn't sit down until the phone stopped ringing.
As soon as he sat down, the phone rang.
q.e: "No sooner … than" = "as soon as" (-er -mez).

q.q: The film is not as good as the book.
o: The film is better than the book.
The book is not as long as the film.
The book is better than the film.
Neither the film nor the book is good.
The film and the book are equally good.
q.e: "Not as good as" = daha iyi değil; yani kitap filmden daha iyi.

q.q: You needn't have bought so much food; we already had plenty.
o: It wasn't necessary for you to buy so much food because we already had plenty.
You must buy more food because we don't have enough.
You bought too little food for the party.
You didn't buy any food, which was a good decision.
You should have bought more food because we didn't have enough.
q.e: "Needn't have + V3" = gerek yoktu ama yaptın.

q.q: The more you read, the larger your vocabulary becomes.
o: Reading more helps you develop a larger vocabulary.
Reading is not the only way to improve your vocabulary.
You need a large vocabulary in order to read more.
Your vocabulary becomes larger when you write more.
People with a large vocabulary read less.
q.e: "The more …, the larger …" ile ifade edilen doğru orantı A şıkkında korunmuş.

q.q: Few people attended the meeting, which surprised the organizers.
o: The organizers were surprised that only a small number of people came to the meeting.
A lot of people attended the meeting, as the organizers had hoped.
The organizers didn't attend the meeting, which surprised everyone.
The organizers expected only a few people to attend the meeting.
The meeting was cancelled because few people attended.
q.e: "Few people" = az sayıda kişi (olumsuz anlam); organizatörler şaşırdı.

q.q: She must have left her keys at the office.
o: She should have left her keys at the office.
She has to leave her keys at the office.
It is very likely that she left her keys at the office.
It is impossible that she left her keys at the office.
She might leave her keys at the office tomorrow.
q.e: "Must have + V3" = geçmişe yönelik güçlü tahmin: büyük olasılıkla bıraktı.

q.q: Many people think that bats are blind. ---- In fact, most bats can see quite well. However, at night they mainly rely on a different sense called echolocation. They make high-pitched sounds and listen to the echoes in order to find their way and catch insects.
o: Some bats eat fruit instead of insects.
Many people are afraid of bats.
Bats usually live in large groups in caves.
This, however, is a common misconception.
Bats are the only mammals that can fly.
q.e: Boşluktan sonraki "In fact, most bats can see quite well" cümlesi önceki inancı düzeltiyor. Aradaki cümle bu inancın yanlış olduğunu söylemeli: "Bu yaygın bir yanılgıdır."

q.q: Coffee is one of the most popular drinks in the world. ---- In Brazil, the largest producer, millions of people depend on it for their living. However, coffee plants are very sensitive to temperature, and climate change is threatening production in many regions.
o: It is grown in more than 70 countries, mostly in tropical regions.
Too much caffeine can cause sleep problems.
Coffee was first discovered in Ethiopia centuries ago.
Tea is also very popular in Asia.
Many people drink coffee in the morning.
q.e: Sonraki cümle üretimden (Brazil, the largest producer) söz ediyor. Boşluk da üretimle ilgili olmalı: 70'ten fazla ülkede yetiştiriliyor.

q.q: In the past, most people worked on farms. Today, however, only a small percentage of the population works in agriculture. ---- As a result, farms today can produce much more food with far fewer workers.
o: Many people prefer to live in the countryside.
Farmers usually get up very early in the morning.
This change is mainly due to the use of machines and modern farming methods.
Some crops need a lot of water to grow.
Food prices have risen sharply in recent years.
q.e: "As a result" ile başlayan son cümle bir sonucu anlatıyor; boşluk bu sonucun nedenini vermeli: makineler ve modern yöntemler.

q.q: Learning a new language takes time and effort. Many learners give up because they do not see quick results. ---- For example, studying for twenty minutes every day is more effective than studying for three hours once a week.
o: Grammar is the most difficult part of learning a language.
Children learn languages faster than adults.
Some people learn languages by watching films.
Experts say that regular, short study sessions work better than long, occasional ones.
English is spoken in many countries around the world.
q.e: "For example" ile verilen örnek (günde 20 dakika > haftada bir 3 saat) genel bir ilkeyi örneklemeli: düzenli kısa çalışma daha etkilidir.

q.q: The Great Wall of China is one of the most famous structures in the world. ---- It was built over many centuries to protect China from invasions. Contrary to popular belief, however, it cannot be seen from space with the naked eye.
o: Many tourists visit Beijing every year.
The Chinese invented paper and printing.
China has the largest population in the world.
It stretches for thousands of kilometres across northern China.
Space travel has become more common recently.
q.e: Paragraf duvarın kendisini tanıtıyor; boşluk duvar hakkında bir özellik vermeli: binlerce kilometre boyunca uzanıyor.

q.q: Plastic is cheap, light and durable. ---- But these same qualities also make it a serious environmental problem. Because it does not break down easily, plastic waste can remain in nature for hundreds of years.
o: Recycling is the best solution to the plastic problem.
This is why it is used in so many products, from bottles to cars.
Plastic was invented in the early twentieth century.
The oceans are full of fish and other creatures.
Some countries have banned plastic bags.
q.e: Sonraki cümle "But these same qualities" diyor; yani önce bu özelliklerin olumlu sonucu verilmeli: bu yüzden birçok üründe kullanılıyor.

q.q: (I) Honey bees live in large groups called colonies. (II) Each colony has a single queen, whose main job is to lay eggs. (III) Some people are allergic to bee stings and need medical help. (IV) Worker bees collect food, clean the hive and look after the young. (V) Male bees, called drones, exist only to mate with the queen.
q.e: Paragraf arı kolonisindeki görev dağılımını anlatıyor (kraliçe, işçiler, erkek arılar). III. cümledeki arı sokmasına alerji konusu bu akışı bozuyor.

q.q: (I) The Olympic Games began in ancient Greece more than 2,700 years ago. (II) They were held every four years in honour of the god Zeus. (III) Greece is famous for its beautiful islands and beaches. (IV) Only free Greek men were allowed to take part. (V) The modern Olympics were revived in 1896 in Athens.
q.e: Paragraf Olimpiyat Oyunlarının tarihini anlatıyor. III. cümle Yunanistan'ın adaları ve plajlarıyla ilgili; konuyla ilgisiz.

q.q: (I) Regular exercise has many benefits for mental health. (II) It reduces stress and helps people sleep better. (III) It also releases chemicals in the brain that improve mood. (IV) Many gyms offer discounts to students. (V) For these reasons, doctors often recommend exercise to people with mild depression.
q.e: Paragraf egzersizin ruh sağlığına faydalarını anlatıyor. IV. cümledeki spor salonu indirimleri konu dışı.

q.q: (I) Volcanoes form when hot melted rock rises from deep inside the Earth. (II) When pressure builds up, this rock can explode through the surface. (III) Volcanic eruptions can destroy towns and kill thousands of people. (IV) However, volcanic soil is very fertile, which is why many farmers live near volcanoes. (V) Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
q.e: Paragraf volkanları anlatıyor. V. cümledeki Everest bir volkan değildir ve akışla ilgisi yok.

q.q: (I) Social media allows people to stay in touch with friends and family. (II) However, spending too much time on it can have negative effects. (III) Some studies link heavy social media use to anxiety and loneliness. (IV) Smartphones were first introduced in the 1990s. (V) Experts therefore advise limiting the time spent online.
q.e: Paragraf sosyal medyanın etkilerini tartışıyor. IV. cümledeki akıllı telefonların tarihi bilgisi akışı bozuyor.

q.q: (I) Tea was first drunk in China thousands of years ago. (II) It later spread to Japan, India and eventually Europe. (III) In Britain, it became so popular that afternoon tea turned into a national tradition. (IV) Coffee contains more caffeine than tea. (V) Today, tea is the second most consumed drink in the world after water.
q.e: Paragraf çayın tarihini ve yayılışını anlatıyor. IV. cümledeki kahve-çay kafein karşılaştırması konunun akışını bozuyor.

q.q: If it hadn't been for her help, I would never have finished the project.
o: She asked me to help her finish the project.
She helped me, but I still couldn't finish the project.
I finished the project and then helped her.
I would have finished the project faster without her help.
Without her help, I would never have finished the project.
q.e: "If it hadn't been for" = "without" (… olmasaydı). Anlam: onun yardımı olmasaydı bitiremezdim.

q.q: Hardly had the plane taken off when the pilot reported a technical problem.
o: The pilot reported a technical problem immediately after the plane took off.
The plane couldn't take off because of a technical problem.
The pilot didn't notice the technical problem until the plane landed.
The pilot reported a technical problem before the plane took off.
The plane took off long after the pilot reported a problem.
q.e: "Hardly … when" = tam … ki; uçak kalkar kalkmaz pilot sorun bildirdi.

q.q: The museum is so popular that you have to buy tickets weeks in advance.
o: Tickets for the museum are sold only a few weeks a year.
You have to visit the museum weeks after buying the tickets.
You can buy tickets for the museum on the day you visit.
The museum is such a popular place that tickets must be bought weeks in advance.
The museum is not very popular, so tickets are cheap.
q.e: "So + sıfat + that" = "such a + sıfat + isim + that". Anlam korunuyor.

q.q: Neither the manager nor his assistant knew about the problem.
o: The manager knew about the problem, but his assistant didn't.
The assistant told the manager about the problem.
Both the manager and his assistant were unaware of the problem.
Either the manager or his assistant knew about the problem.
Only the manager was aware of the problem.
q.e: "Neither … nor" = ikisi de bilmiyordu = both were unaware.

q.q: The Amazon rainforest is often called "the lungs of the Earth". ---- It also contains about ten per cent of all known species. Sadly, large areas of the forest are cut down every year for farming and timber.
o: The Amazon River is the second longest river in the world.
Brazil is the largest country in South America.
Rainforests receive a lot of rain throughout the year.
Many tourists visit the rainforest every year.
This is because it produces a large share of the world's oxygen.
q.e: "Dünyanın akciğerleri" benzetmesinin nedeni verilmeli: oksijenin büyük kısmını üretiyor. "It also contains" de önceki cümlenin ormanın bir başka özelliğini verdiğini gösteriyor.

q.q: Many people believe that eating late at night causes weight gain. ---- What matters most is the total number of calories you eat during the day. Nevertheless, eating a heavy meal just before bed can disturb your sleep.
o: However, research suggests that the timing of meals is less important than people think.
Some people eat five small meals a day.
Breakfast is the most important meal of the day.
Sleep is essential for good health.
Fruit and vegetables are rich in vitamins.
q.e: Sonraki cümle "asıl önemli olan toplam kalori" diyor; boşlukta yaygın inancı sorgulayan However cümlesi olmalı.

q.q: Ancient Egyptians built the pyramids more than 4,500 years ago. For a long time, people believed they were built by slaves. ---- These workers were paid, fed and even given medical care. Their tombs were found near the pyramids.
o: Egypt is famous for the River Nile.
Many tourists visit Egypt every year.
The pyramids were made of large stone blocks.
The pyramids are the only ancient wonder still standing.
However, recent archaeological discoveries show that skilled workers built them.
q.e: Sonraki cümle "These workers were paid" diyor; boşlukta köle inancını düzelten ve işçilerden söz eden cümle olmalı.

q.q: Sharks have existed for more than 400 million years, even longer than trees. ---- In fact, humans kill about 100 million sharks every year, while sharks kill fewer than ten people. As a result, many shark species are now endangered.
o: Sharks have several rows of sharp teeth.
Some sharks can grow up to twelve metres long.
Despite their frightening reputation, sharks are far more at risk from humans than humans are from them.
Sharks live in all the oceans of the world.
Many films have been made about sharks.
q.e: "In fact" ile verilen rakamlar insanların köpekbalıklarına daha çok zarar verdiğini gösteriyor; boşluk bu fikri ortaya koymalı.

q.q: Laughter is good for your health. It reduces stress hormones and strengthens the immune system. ---- This may explain why people who laugh often tend to have more friends. Some hospitals even use humour as part of patients' treatment.
o: Laughing with others also helps to build social bonds.
Some people never laugh at jokes.
Stress can cause many health problems.
Children laugh more often than adults.
q.e: Sonraki cümle "This may explain why people who laugh often have more friends" diyor; boşlukta gülmenin sosyal bağları güçlendirdiği söylenmeli.

q.q: The first computers were enormous machines that filled entire rooms. ---- Today, a smartphone in your pocket is millions of times more powerful. This rapid progress has changed almost every aspect of our lives.
o: The internet was invented in the 1960s.
Computer games are popular among teenagers.
Many people now work from home.
They were also extremely expensive and could perform only simple calculations.
q.e: Paragraf ilk bilgisayarları bugünküyle karşılaştırıyor; boşluk ilk bilgisayarların bir özelliğini daha vermeli.

q.q: (I) Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth. (II) Temperatures there can fall below minus 80 degrees Celsius. (III) Almost the entire continent is covered by a thick sheet of ice. (IV) Penguins are excellent swimmers but cannot fly. (V) No people live there permanently, apart from scientists at research stations.
q.e: Paragraf Antarktika'nın iklimini ve koşullarını anlatıyor. IV. cümle penguenlerin özelliklerine geçiyor ve akışı bozuyor.

q.q: (I) Many cities are trying to reduce traffic in their centres. (II) Some charge drivers a fee to enter certain areas. (III) Others have built more bicycle lanes and improved public transport. (IV) Electric cars are becoming more affordable. (V) As a result, air quality in these cities has improved significantly.
q.e: Paragraf şehir merkezlerindeki trafiği azaltma önlemlerini anlatıyor. IV. cümledeki elektrikli araçların ucuzlaması bu önlemlerden biri değil.

q.q: (I) Reading to young children has many benefits. (II) It helps them develop language skills and a larger vocabulary. (III) It also improves their concentration and imagination. (IV) Many famous writers started writing at a very young age. (V) Therefore, experts recommend reading to children every day.
q.e: Paragraf çocuklara kitap okumanın faydalarını anlatıyor. IV. cümledeki ünlü yazarların erken yaşta yazmaya başlaması konu dışı.

q.q: (I) Elephants are known for their excellent memory. (II) They can remember the locations of water sources many kilometres away. (III) They also recognize other elephants even after years of separation. (IV) Elephants are the largest land animals in the world. (V) This ability helps them survive in harsh environments.
q.e: Paragraf filin hafızasını anlatıyor; V. cümledeki "this ability" de hafızaya gönderme yapıyor. IV. cümledeki büyüklük bilgisi akışı bozuyor.

q.q: (I) The invention of the light bulb changed daily life dramatically. (II) Before electric light, people relied on candles and oil lamps. (III) Electric light allowed factories to work at night and people to read after dark. (IV) Thomas Edison was born in the United States in 1847. (V) It also made streets safer by reducing crime at night.
q.e: Paragraf ampulün günlük hayata etkisini anlatıyor. IV. cümledeki Edison'ın doğum bilgisi akışı bozuyor.

q.q: (I) Deserts cover about one third of the Earth's land surface. (II) Contrary to popular belief, not all deserts are hot. (III) Antarctica, for example, is technically the largest desert in the world. (IV) Camels can survive for weeks without drinking water. (V) A desert is defined by low rainfall, not by temperature.
q.e: Paragraf çöllerin tanımını anlatıyor (sıcaklık değil yağış). IV. cümledeki develer konu dışı.

q.q: Although she had studied English for many years, ----.
o: she passed the exam with a high score
she decided to become an English teacher
she still found it difficult to understand native speakers
q.e: Although zıtlık ister: yıllarca çalışmasına rağmen hâlâ anlamakta zorlanıyordu.

q.q: The company will have to reduce its prices ----.
o: because its products are the cheapest on the market
unless its prices are already too high
so that its profits fell last year
if it wants to compete with its rivals
q.e: Fiyat indirmenin mantıklı koşulu: rakiplerle rekabet etmek istiyorsa.

q.q: ----, the number of people learning foreign languages online has increased dramatically.
o: By the time the internet was invented
Since the internet became widely available
Although few people use the internet
q.e: Present perfect (has increased) ile since + geçmiş olay uyumlu: internet yaygınlaştığından beri.

q.q: Scientists warn that the number of species facing extinction could double by 2050 ----.
o: unless more is done to protect their habitats
so that more animals can live in zoos
q.e: Uyarının koşulu: yaşam alanlarını korumak için daha fazlası yapılmazsa.

q.q: The ancient manuscript was written in a language ----.
o: who is spoken by millions of people
that no one has been able to understand
q.e: Language (dil) için ilgi zamiri that; diğerleri dilbilgisel olarak hatalı.

q.q: Many people prefer to shop online ----.
o: because it saves them time and offers more choice
so that the shops close early
q.e: Online alışverişi tercih etme nedeni: zaman kazandırması ve daha çok seçenek sunması.

q.q: ----, he would have caught the train.
o: If he had left home ten minutes earlier
If he leaves home on time
q.e: "Would have caught" Type 3 ana cümlesidir; koşul tarafı past perfect ister.

q.q: Even though the evidence against him was strong, ----.
o: the jury found him not guilty
he was sent to prison for ten years
q.e: "Even though" zıtlık: kanıt güçlü olmasına rağmen jüri suçsuz buldu.

q.q: Global temperatures have risen by about one degree since 1900, ----.
o: so that the ice caps are growing
which has led to more frequent heatwaves
q.e: ", which has led to" önceki cümlenin sonucunu verir: sıcak hava dalgalarında artış.

q.q: Only after the accident ----.
o: people drove carefully on the road
the city council decided to repair the road
had the road been repaired before
did the city council decide to repair the road
q.e: "Only after" cümle başında olduğunda devrik yapı gelir: did the city council decide.

cloze.title: Sleep and Learning
cloze.p: Sleep is essential for learning. During sleep, the brain processes the information it (1)---- during the day. Studies show that students who sleep well remember more, (2)---- those who stay up late to study often perform worse. This is because the brain needs time (3)---- new memories. Lack of sleep also affects mood, (4)---- makes it harder to concentrate. Experts therefore recommend at least seven hours of sleep a night, (5)---- before an important exam.

qs.e: Gün boyunca aldığı bilgi, uykudan önce tamamlanmış bir eylem; geniş zamanlı ana cümlede present perfect (has received) uygun.
İyi uyuyanlar ile geç saate kadar çalışanlar karşılaştırılıyor: zıtlık bağlacı whereas.
"Need time to do" kalıbı: zaman gerekir + to + fiil.
Virgülden sonra önceki cümlenin tamamını niteleyen which gelir; that virgülden sonra kullanılmaz.
Özellikle önemli bir sınavdan önce: especially.

cloze.title: The Rise of Electric Cars
cloze.p: Electric cars are becoming more popular around the world. In 2015, they made up less than one per cent of new car sales, but this figure (1)---- to more than fifteen per cent today. One reason is that batteries have become cheaper and more (2)----. In addition, many governments offer tax incentives (3)---- encourage people to buy them. (4)----, some problems remain. Charging stations are still rare in rural areas, and the production of batteries requires large amounts of energy. Nevertheless, most experts believe that electric cars will (5)---- replace petrol cars in the coming decades.

qs.e: Geçmişten bugüne (today) uzanan bir değişim: present perfect (has risen).
"More + sıfat" yapısı ve olumlu anlam: efficient (verimli). Cheaper ile paralel bir sıfat gerekir.
Amaç bildiren ve yalın fiil alan yapı: in order to encourage. So that'ten sonra özne + fiil gelir.
Önceki olumlu bilgilere zıt olarak sorunlar geliyor: However.
Gelecekte sonunda yerini alacak: eventually (nihayetinde).

cloze.title: Bilingual Children
cloze.p: Children who grow up speaking two languages enjoy several advantages. Research suggests that bilingual children are often better at (1)---- attention and switching between tasks. This may be because they constantly have to choose (2)---- language to use. Some parents worry that learning two languages at the same time might confuse young children. (3)----, there is little evidence to support this fear. Although bilingual children sometimes start speaking slightly later, they usually (4)---- up with their peers by the age of five. Experts therefore encourage parents (5)---- both languages at home.

qs.e: "Be good at" kalıbında at bir edattır; edattan sonra fiil -ing alır.
İki dil arasından seçim: "hangi dili kullanacakları" = which language.
Ebeveynlerin endişesine karşın kanıt yok: zıtlık bağlacı However.
"Catch up with" = yetişmek, arayı kapatmak. Akranlarına beş yaşına kadar yetişirler.
"Encourage someone to do" kalıbı: to + fiil.

cloze.title: Coral Reefs
cloze.p: Coral reefs cover less than one per cent of the ocean floor, (1)---- they are home to about a quarter of all marine species. Unfortunately, they are in serious danger. Rising sea temperatures cause corals to lose the tiny algae (2)---- live inside them and give them their colour. This process, (3)---- as coral bleaching, can kill entire reefs if it continues for too long. Pollution and overfishing (4)---- the problem even worse. Scientists warn that unless urgent action is taken, most of the world's reefs could disappear (5)---- the end of this century.

qs.e: Okyanus tabanının çok küçük bir kısmını kaplıyorlar ama türlerin dörtte birine ev sahipliği yapıyorlar: zıtlık bağlacı yet (ama).
Algae (canlılar) için özne konumunda ilgi zamiri: that (ya da which). What burada kullanılamaz.
"Known as" = olarak bilinen. Kısaltılmış edilgen ilgi cümleciği (which is known as).
"Make something worse" = bir şeyi daha kötü hale getirmek.
"By the end of this century" = bu yüzyılın sonuna kadar (bir son nokta).

cloze.title: Fast Food
cloze.p: Fast food has become part of daily life for millions of people. It is cheap, quick and easy (1)---- find. However, doctors warn that eating it too often can lead (2)---- serious health problems, such as obesity and heart disease. Most fast food is high in salt, sugar and fat, (3)---- it contains few vitamins. (4)---- the risks, the industry continues to grow, especially in developing countries. Experts suggest that schools should teach children about healthy eating (5)---- they can make better choices.

qs.e: "Easy to find" = bulması kolay. Sıfat + to + fiil yapısı.
"Lead to" = yol açmak.
Yüksek tuz, şeker ve yağa karşın az vitamin: iki durumu karşılaştıran while.
Risklere rağmen ve arkasından isim (the risks) geliyor: Despite. Although'dan sonra cümle gelir.
Amaç ve arkasından özne + fiil (they can make): so that.

cloze.title: The Silk Road
cloze.p: The Silk Road was not a single road but a network of trade routes (1)---- connected China with the Mediterranean. For more than a thousand years, merchants carried silk, spices and other goods (2)---- these routes. However, trade was not the only thing that travelled along them. Ideas, religions and technologies also (3)---- from one culture to another. Paper, for instance, (4)---- in China and later reached Europe through the Silk Road. (5)----, the routes played a key role in shaping the modern world.

qs.e: Routes (yollar) için özne konumunda ilgi zamiri: that.
"Along these routes" = bu yollar boyunca.
Geçmişte olan bir olay; spread düzensiz fiildir ve geçmiş hâli de spread'dir.
Kâğıt kendisi icat etmez, icat edilir: edilgen ve geçmiş (was invented).
Önceki bilgilerin vardığı sonuç: Therefore (bu nedenle).

cloze.title: Volunteering
cloze.p: Volunteering means giving your time to help others without (1)---- paid. Many people volunteer at hospitals, schools or animal shelters. Research shows that volunteering benefits not only the people who receive help (2)---- the volunteers themselves. People who volunteer regularly report (3)---- levels of stress and a greater sense of purpose. Some studies have even found that older volunteers live longer than those who do not volunteer. (4)----, it is important to choose an activity you enjoy; (5)----, you may soon lose interest.

qs.e: "Without" bir edattır; ardından -ing gelir. Edilgen anlam (ücret almadan) için being paid.
"Not only … but also" ikili bağlacı.
"Levels" ile birlikte daha düşük seviye: lower levels of stress.
Faydalar anlatıldıktan sonra bir uyarı geliyor: However.
"Sevdiğin bir etkinlik seç; aksi halde ilgini kaybedebilirsin": otherwise.

cloze.title: Earthquakes
cloze.p: Earthquakes happen when large pieces of the Earth's crust suddenly move. Most of them occur along the boundaries between tectonic plates, (1)---- is why countries such as Japan and Turkey experience them frequently. Although scientists cannot yet predict exactly (2)---- an earthquake will happen, they can identify high-risk areas. Buildings in these areas must be designed (3)---- strong shaking. Experience has shown that well-built structures can save thousands of lives. (4)----, many older buildings do not meet modern standards, and (5)---- them is expensive.

qs.e: Önceki cümlenin tamamını niteleyen virgüllü yapı: ", which is why…" = işte bu yüzden.
"Depremin tam olarak ne zaman olacağını" = when.
Amaç: "güçlü sarsıntıya dayanmak için tasarlanmalı" = to withstand.
Olumlu bilginin ardından olumsuz bir durum geliyor: Unfortunately.
Cümlenin öznesi bir eylem: "onları güçlendirmek pahalıdır" = strengthening them (gerund özne).
